reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten form, clear hand. PAGES ARE OUT OF ORDER IN THE PDF and the locator therefore found no summary page (it fell back to the last page, which is a Schedule A sheet). The filer hand-numbered every sheet: PDF p1 is the cover marked 'Pg 8 of 8', PDF p2 is the SUMMARY PAGE marked 'Pg 1 of 8', PDF p3 is a Schedule B marked 'Pg 7 of 8', PDF p8 is a Schedule A marked 'Pg 2 of 8'. Pages 2-7 were rendered for this read because the summary image was missing from the pre-rendered set. CENTS CONVENTION: this filer writes cents as a raised superscript after the dollars (A '26,522' with a superscript 23, D '43,477' superscript 05, E '50,847' superscript 22, F '71,798' superscript 23, G '28,321' superscript 18) - transcribed with a decimal point. Boxes B and C are written with NO cents at all ('45,276', '52,096') and are preserved that way, not padded. This revision labels the close box 'G'; it prints no 'v.' version string, so form_version is ''. Schedule totals on the itemization sheets corroborate the summary: Schedule A 'Total Contributions Received $45,276' matches Box B (that page's subtotal figure was struck through and rewritten - the surviving value is 19,776 for the page subtotal and 45,276 for the report total), and Schedule B 'Total Expenditures Made $43,477.05' matches Box D. Office 'Commission Seat B' agrees with index.csv.
